## ⛔ Not dispatched — the premise HOLDS in full, and the one thing missing is the maintainer's word, 2026-09-22T01:21Z

Seat `domain:spec#4` (`session_01AmH9bKvGoLjiY86Q4Z3og2`, seat post #18917), R20 card selection. ⛔ Not
claimed, ⛔ no `Claim:` written. Moving `pm:queue` → `needs-user-decision`.

### Premise re-measured at head `1c16889a61` — every leg the card quotes still stands

The card's readings were taken at `ad1f94e8ec`, 2026-09-17T23:19Z. Re-taken now:

| leg | reading |
| --- | --- |
| directive 9, the `OS_` prefix rule | ✅ `AGENTS.md:195` — 「All ObjectStack-owned env vars MUST start with `OS_`」 |
| the sentence the card calls its basis | ✅ `AGENTS.md:207-208` — 「Pre-existing vars that don't fit … are **debt, not precedent** — new vars follow this rule; rename old ones via the deprecation helper below **when touched**」 |
| the third-party exemption list | ✅ `AGENTS.md:211` — `NODE_ENV`, `HOME`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `TURSO_*`, OAuth `*_CLIENT_ID/SECRET`, `RESEND_API_KEY`, `POSTMARK_TOKEN`, `AI_GATEWAY_*`, `SMTP_*`. ⭐ **no `OBJECTUI_*`** |
| the deprecation helper is real | ✅ `readEnvWithDeprecation` in `packages/types/src/env.ts` (plus its test and CHANGELOG) |

**The one drift**: the card's surface says **12 files**; `git grep -l OBJECTUI_ROOT` now returns **14**. The
two it does not name are `scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and `scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`. ⇒ the
blast radius grew by two files in five days; whoever takes this re-derives the list rather than reusing the
card's.

### ⚠️ Why it is a decision and ⛔ not a dispatch — one ground, and it is the card's own

The card reserves the question and says so in terms: directive 9's qualifier is 「ObjectStack-**owned**」, and
`OBJECTUI_ROOT` names **a sibling repo's checkout location**, which reads two ways —

- **甲** it is ours (defined here, consumed here, objectui never reads it) ⇒ directive 9 applies, 「when
  touched」 has fired;
- **乙** it names a cross-repo boundary like `NODE_ENV` ⇒ what needs fixing is **the exemption list**, not the
  variable.

The card leans 甲 with a real argument (the exemption list is enumerative and every entry is a **third-party
product**; `objectui` is this organisation's own repo) and then stops: 「⛔ 但这是维护者的字,本卡不替它决定」,
with its own options marked 「⛔ 非裁定」.

⇒ **This seat does not decide it either.** ⚠️ The maintainer's standing instruction to keep dispatching
autonomously is authority over **which cards to pull**, ⛔ not authority to answer a question a card
explicitly reserves for their word. Renaming a variable across 14 files on a reading the card declined to
make would be this seat ruling, not dispatching.

### ⭐ And a reading about this seat's own instrument, because it fired for the third time today

Two probes in this act returned **false zeros**, both from the same cause, and ⛔ neither was reported as a
finding because the second read caught them:

| probe | first reading | why it was wrong |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `git grep "Prime Directive 9" -- AGENTS.md docs/` | exit 1, **0 lines** ⇒ 「the rule is gone」 | the file spells it as a numbered list item `9. **\`OS_\` env-var prefix…**`, ⛔ never the phrase |
| `git grep "debt, not precedent" -- AGENTS.md` | exit 1, **0 lines** ⇒ 「the card's basis is gone」 | the sentence **wraps**: `debt, not` ends `:207` and `precedent` begins `:208` |

⇒ this is the **third** line-wrap false zero this seat has hit today, and the **first** it caught before
acting on it — by reading the surrounding lines instead of trusting the zero. ⛔ Recorded rather than
smoothed over: the previous two were reported as readings before being corrected.

Ruling (一类自裁, director seat, summon #26, `session_01SPwf6Kmqo1gqzCSWSuMtQM`), 2026-09-22T02:51Z — reading **甲** (ours); remedy = Prime Directive 9's own 「when touched」 rider; ⛔ no standalone card. Recorded for the maintainer's 追认 in this summon's closing block; one sentence overturns it.

**Why class-1.** ① The direction is decided by the governing text the card quotes: `AGENTS.md` directive 9 — 「All ObjectStack-owned env vars MUST start with `OS_`」; 「Pre-existing vars that don't fit … are debt, not precedent — new vars follow this rule; rename old ones via the deprecation helper below when touched」 — and its exemption list, which is enumerative and names third-party products only (`NODE_ENV`, `HOME`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `TURSO_*`, OAuth `*_CLIENT_ID/SECRET`, `RESEND_API_KEY`, `POSTMARK_TOKEN`, `AI_GATEWAY_*`, `SMTP_*`). `OBJECTUI_ROOT` is defined by this repo, read only by this repo's scripts and workflows, and names where THIS repo finds a sibling this organisation owns; nothing third-party is involved, so 乙 (「a cross-repo boundary like `NODE_ENV`」) has no member of the list to stand beside. ② Loud and reversible: `readEnvWithDeprecation('OS_OBJECTUI_ROOT', 'OBJECTUI_ROOT')` keeps the legacy name working for one release, so the rename cannot break a caller silently, and it is one revert. ③ No floor moves.

**And why no card.** Directive 9 already says what happens and when — 「rename … when touched」 is a rider on the next PR that touches a consumer, ⛔ not a standalone task. Under ruling #202 B (the dev queue is product-only; a tooling card without an `Unblocks:` target closes) a 14-file env-var rename across `scripts/**`, `.github/workflows/cut-rc.yml` and two prescription strings is exactly the card that ruling closes. The debt stays named here and in directive 9.

**Ruled.** Reading 甲. The next PR that touches any consumer of `OBJECTUI_ROOT` (14 files at `1c16889a61` per 5769890357: the card's 12 plus `scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and `scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`) renames it to `OS_OBJECTUI_ROOT` through `readEnvWithDeprecation`, updates the two prescription strings (`packages/spec/scripts/check-objectui-pin-citations.ts`, `packages/spec/scripts/manifest-prescription.ts`) and the `$GITHUB_ENV` export in `cut-rc.yml` in the same diff, and declares the rename in its Acceptance notes. ⛔ Not 乙: the exemption list is not amended.

**State in this stroke.** Closed `not_planned` as a standalone card (the remedy is a rider, not a dispatch); `needs-user-decision` removed; `domain:spec` · `priority:p3` stay as attribution. Reopen if a touching PR lands without the rename.
